recipes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
ingredients: Butter or oil for the pan
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a pan on medium and add a little butter.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake.
Cook for 2 minutes, until bubbles pop on top, then flip.
Cook the other side for 1 minute until golden. Serve with syrup or fruit.

recipes.name: Crispy Waffles
steps: Heat up the waffle iron.
Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet mix into the dry mix until just combined.
Spray the waffle iron and pour in enough batter to cover it.
Close it and cook for 4 minutes, until golden and crispy.
Repeat with the rest of the batter.

recipes.name: French Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Heat a pan on medium and melt a little butter.
Dip a slice of bread in the egg mix, flipping so both sides soak.
Cook it for 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Repeat with the other slices. Top with syrup, powdered sugar or berries.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk and salt, and whisk with a fork.
Melt the butter in a pan on medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and wait 20 seconds.
Gently push the eggs around with a spatula until soft curds form, about 3 minutes.
Take them off the heat while they still look a little wet. They finish cooking on the plate.

recipes.name: Cheese Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and salt in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a small pan on medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan so they spread out.
Cook for 2 minutes, lifting the edges so the runny egg slides under.
Sprinkle the cheese and fillings on one half.
Fold the other half over and cook for 1 minute more, then slide it onto a plate.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.time: 5 minutes, plus a night in the fridge
ingredients: 1 handful of berries or banana slices
steps: Put the oats, milk, yogurt and honey in a jar.
Stir well and put the lid on.
Leave it in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, stir it and add the fruit on top.

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon some yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of granola, then a layer of berries.
Repeat the layers until the glass is full.
Drizzle honey on top and eat it right away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F (190 C) and line a baking tray with paper.
Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop balls of dough about 2 inches apart on the tray.
Bake for 10 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them.

recipes.name: Sugar Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F (175 C) and line a tray with paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Roll the dough into balls, roll them in sprinkles and put them on the tray.
Flatten each one a little with a glass.
Bake for 9 minutes, until the edges are just set.
Cool for 5 minutes on the tray.

recipes.name: 3-Ingredient Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F (175 C) and line a tray with paper.
Mix the peanut butter, sugar and egg until smooth.
Roll into 12 balls and put them on the tray.
Press a fork into each one twice to make a criss-cross.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Let them cool for 10 minutes. They firm up as they cool.

recipes.name: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F (175 C) and grease an 8-inch square pan.
Melt the butter, then stir in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake for 25 minutes, until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool for 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F (175 C) and grease a loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a big bowl.
Stir in the melted butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle in the baking soda and salt, then stir in the flour.
Pour the batter into the pan.
Bake for 55 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes, then take it out of the pan.

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F (200 C) and put paper cups in a muffin tin.
Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the oil, egg and milk, then stir them into the dry mix.
Gently fold in the blueberries.
Fill each cup about 3/4 full.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden on top.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder in a big mug.
Stir in the milk and oil until smooth.
Drop the chocolate chips on top.
Microwave for 1 minute.
Let it cool for 1 minute. The mug is hot, so hold it by the handle.

recipes.name: Vanilla Cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F (175 C) and put paper cups in a muffin tin.
Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add the butter, eggs, milk and vanilla and beat for 2 minutes until smooth.
Fill each cup halfway.
Bake for 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, about 30 minutes, then frost and add sprinkles.

recipes.name: Crispy Rice Treats
steps: Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Melt the butter in a big pot on low heat.
Add the marshmallows and stir until melted.
Take it off the heat and stir in the cereal.
Press it into the pan with a greased spatula.
Let it cool for 30 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: No-Bake Energy Bites
steps: Mix everything in a bowl.
Chill it in the fridge for 20 minutes so it's easier to roll.
Roll into small balls.
Keep them in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 8 minutes, then drain it.
In the same pot, melt the butter on medium heat.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cook until it thickens, about 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in the cheese and salt until melted.
Stir the macaroni back in and serve.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with Tomato Sauce
steps: Boil a big pot of salted water.
Cook the spaghetti for 10 minutes, then drain it.
While it cooks, heat the oil in a pan and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, salt and basil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and top with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Put one slice butter-side down in a cold pan and add the cheese.
Put the other slice on top, butter-side up.
Cook on medium-low for 3 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook for 3 minutes more, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Put one tortilla in a pan on medium heat.
Sprinkle the cheese and any fillings on top.
Put the second tortilla on top.
Cook for 2 minutes until the bottom is golden.
Flip it carefully and cook for 2 minutes more.
Cut into triangles and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning (or 1 tablespoon chili powder, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1/2 teaspoon salt)
steps: Brown the beef in a pan on medium-high heat for 7 minutes, breaking it up.
Drain off the extra fat.
Stir in the seasoning and water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the taco shells in the oven or microwave.
Fill the shells with beef and add lettuce, cheese, tomatoes and salsa.

recipes.name: Quick Pita Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F (220 C).
Put the pitas on a baking tray.
Spread sauce on each one and sprinkle the cheese.
Add your toppings.
Bake for 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat the oil in a big pan on medium-high.
Add the peas and carrots and cook for 3 minutes.
Push them to the side, crack in the eggs and scramble them.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Upgraded Instant Ramen
steps: Bring the water to a boil.
Add the noodles and veggies and cook for 2 minutes.
Crack in the egg and cook for 1 minute more without stirring.
Turn off the heat and stir in half the flavor packet and the soy sauce.
Top with green onion.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F (200 C) and line a tray with paper.
Whisk the egg in a bowl.
Mix the breadcrumbs, Parmesan, salt and garlic powder in another bowl.
Dip each piece in egg, then roll it in crumbs and put it on the tray.
Bake for 18 minutes, flipping halfway, until cooked through.
Wash your hands after touching raw chicken!

recipes.name: Classic Burgers
steps: Split the beef into 4 balls and flatten them into patties.
Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot pan or grill for 4 minutes.
Flip, add cheese, and cook for 4 minutes more.
Rest for 2 minutes, then put them in the buns with your toppings.

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F (200 C).
Cut the baguette in half the long way.
Mix the butter, garlic, parsley and salt.
Spread it on the cut sides.
Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
Slice and serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy Nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F (200 C).
Spread the chips on a baking tray.
Sprinkle on the beans and cheese.
Bake for 6 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Top with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Cut the avocados in half, take out the pits and scoop them into a bowl.
Mash them with a fork.
Squeeze in the lime juice and add the salt.
Stir in the onion, tomato and cilantro.
Serve right away with chips.

recipes.name: Fresh Salsa
steps: Put the tomatoes, onion and cilantro in a bowl.
Squeeze in the lime juice.
Add the salt and stir.
Let it sit for 10 minutes so the flavors mix.

recipes.name: Stovetop Popcorn
steps: Put the oil and 3 kernels in a big pot with a lid, on medium-high heat.
When the 3 kernels pop, add the rest and put the lid on.
Shake the pot every few seconds.
When the popping slows to 2 seconds apart, about 3 minutes, take it off the heat.
Pour into a bowl and add salt and butter.

recipes.name: Ants on a Log
steps: Wash the celery and cut each stick in half.
Spread peanut butter in the groove.
Line up raisins on top like ants.

recipes.name: Rainbow Fruit Salad
steps: Wash all the fruit.
Cut the strawberries, orange, banana and kiwi into bite-size pieces.
Put everything in a big bowl.
Mix the honey and lemon juice and pour it over.
Stir gently and serve cold.

recipes.name: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
steps: Wash the strawberries and dry them really well.
Microwave the chocolate and oil in 30-second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth.
Dip each strawberry and put it on a tray with paper.
Chill in the fridge for 15 minutes until the chocolate is hard.

recipes.name: Berry Banana Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender.
Put the lid on tight.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into glasses and drink right away.

recipes.name: Strawberry Milkshake
steps: Put the ice cream, strawberries and milk in a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until smooth.
Pour into glasses and top with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Homemade Lemonade
steps: Squeeze the lemons until you have 1 cup of juice.
Stir the sugar into 1 cup of the water until it dissolves.
Pour it into a pitcher with the lemon juice and the rest of the water.
Taste it and add more sugar or water if you want.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate
steps: Whisk the cocoa and sugar with a splash of the milk in a pot until smooth.
Add the rest of the milk.
Heat on medium for 5 minutes, stirring, until hot but not boiling.
Stir in the vanilla.
Pour into mugs and add marshmallows.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Heat the oil in a big pot on medium.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 5 minutes.
Add the broth and bring it to a boil.
Add the noodles and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and salt and heat for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks.
Cover them with cold salted water in a pot and bring it to a boil.
Boil for 15 minutes, until a fork slides in easily.
Drain them and put them back in the pot.
Mash with the butter, milk and salt until smooth.

recipes.name: Baked Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F (220 C).
Scrub the potatoes and poke them a few times with a fork.
Rub them with oil and salt.
Bake right on the oven rack for 50 minutes, until soft inside.
Cut them open and add butter, cheese and sour cream.

recipes.name: Easy Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and dry the lettuce, then tear it into pieces.
Put it in a big bowl with the dressing and toss.
Add the croutons and Parmesan and toss again.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich
steps: Spread peanut butter on one slice of bread.
Spread jelly on the other slice.
Press them together and cut it in half.
